briefdescription.para: Unit tests for ethical compliance evaluation and bias detection in the RAG judge.

detaileddescription.para:
Tests cover:
Ethical compliance scoring via evaluate() (BALANCED mode)
Ethical VETO mechanism (low compliance fails quality threshold)
Computed confidence (not hardcoded 0.85)
BiasDetector: detectPositionBias, detectLengthBias, analyzeAllBiases, applyBiasMitigation, setConfig/getConfig
